answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to commit capital to participate in governance. Like sand shifting in a dune, ephemeral identities are discarded, while stakers demonstrate commitment through assets rather than ferrous compute hardware. By tying voting weight to an onyx layer of cryptographically secured collateral, the system imposes a prohibitive capital cost on attackers attempting to inflate their influence via multiple fraudulent nodes.
